title: Second-floor Condo with High-speed WiFi & Balcony
description:
Stay in a contemporary second-floor downtown Nashville condo with a private balcony, city views, central air conditioning, elevator access, and fast Wi-Fi. The three-bedroom, two-bathroom home sleeps six with one king bed in each bedroom. Enjoy a full kitchen, an in-building gym, and nearby coin laundry during your Music City stay.

The space
Take in a view of the city from your own private balcony, or recline inside in comfort. This stylishly decorated condo features conveniences at every turn, all in a rich color palette. Step inside and play your favorite tunes on the sound dock. The open kitchen features full-sized appliances and plenty of cooking tools to help you put together full meals or post-concert cocktails. Central air-conditioning means you'll be able to relax in any of the themed bedrooms (each featuring modern or music-themed art). The built-in bunk beds are perfect for younger guests to settle in or enjoy a quick nap. Ease in and pull in the room-darkening shades for a restful sleep.

Shared Amenities・Rooftop lounge・Fitness center・Cornhole court・Elevator in the building

Guest access
As our guest, you'll have full access to the entire property, except for a few areas reserved for house supplies.

Other things to note
| ▼ Important |

☑︎ A shared laundry room is available on-site. 
☑︎ The Drip Bar, located next door, is now an official Bounce luggage drop location for guest convenience.

| ▼ Things to Know |

☑︎ Check-in time: 4:00 PM
☑︎ Check-out time: 10:00 AM
☑︎ Quiet Hours: 10:00 PM - 8:00 AM
☑︎ All guests shall abide good neighbor policy and shall not engage in illegal activity.
☑︎ NO smoking is permitted anywhere on the premises.
☑︎ Streaming services available with guests’ own account(s)
